text:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: Pager fired — high 5xx/timeouts on routing-fallback in us-west2. Spike started ~02:17 UTC, ~12% of traffic affected. Incident ID INC-2026-3047. Paging @raja for on-call. Logs + sample traces attached: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026-3047

raja: acked. jumping in. thanks for the page. first pass: check gateway pods, autoscaler, and fallback routing policy. tagging @simon for infra traces.

simon: looking now. seeing increased latency on kv-cache lookups and a bunch of `OOMKilled` on a small subset of model-workers. also seeing a rollback loop for variant B in the last hour. running quick checks:
```
kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide | grep gw
kubectl top pod -n inference | sort -r -k3 | head
curl -sS -D - https://hosted.redwood/api/health | jq .latency_percentiles
```

maria: rolling up mitigation: bumped gateway replica count + forced routing to fallback pool (variant-cold). error rate dropped from 12% -> 3% over ~20m. still seeing intermittent 502s for long tails. continuing to monitor.

alyssa: noted customer impact — two mid-market customers reported timeouts in the 4–6s range and some transient 5xx. CS notified; CS ticket 14922 opened. priority: minimize tail latency and prevent recurrence.

product-lead-sarah: thanks team. schedule a post-incident review and create action items. we need severity-based sizing and tie any work to the Q2 reliability epic. can we outline immediate remediation, root cause investigation (RCA), and ops/runbook changes?

raja: immediate items off top of my head —
- Mitigation (P0): stabilize routing by pinning to variant-cold for affected customers and throttle aggressive autoscaler triggers (owner: raja, ETA: 1-2h, size: S)
- Hotfix (P0): patch worker memory leak suspected in quantized kernel (owner: simon, ETA: 1d for hotfix build + canary, size: M)
- Postmortem (P1): write RCA + timeline and customer impact (owner: alyssa, ETA: 2d, size: M)
- Runbook (P2): add explicit handoff checklist & rollback steps for routing policy (owner: sabrina, ETA: 1 sprint, size: S)

chris: can we add an operational alert to detect the pattern earlier? suggestion: alert when 5xx rate > 2% sustained for 5m AND kv-cache latency p95 > 200ms. owner: leo (size: S), link to alert PR when ready.

leo: i’ll take the alert and dashboard work. quick note: we should also add an automatic fallback to variant-B after X% errors instead of manual toggle. that’s a larger change (size: L) — consider for Q2 roadmap.

pm-beth: I'll create the postmortem ticket and link INC-2026-3047 -> PM-2026-88 (postmortem doc). scheduling: propose Wed 10:00 PT for the postmortem review. adding calendar invite now. :calendar: 

maria: deploy-bot shows we've rolled the replica bump and routing toggle. logs show error rate stable ~3% for last 40m. rolling monitoring to 2h watch window, then handoff to day team.

raja: handing off to day oncall — @alyssa you have it. current status: mitigated (partial), hotfix in progress, alerts assigned, postmortem scheduled. everything documented in INC ticket.

alyssa: taking handoff. quick summary for daytime:
- Mitigations in place: pinned routing to variant-cold, increased gateway replicas
- Ongoing: simon working on kernel hotfix build, leo building alert & dashboard
- Customer comms: CS ticket 14922 open, product-comms drafted, waiting for final RCA
- Monitoring: error rate stable ~3% but watch p99 tail and KV latencies

simon: update — reproducible locally with quantized kernel v1.12. creating a reproduce script and starting bisect. hotfix candidate compile started (est ~6–8h). will do canary on dedicated pool first. linking run: https://ci.redwood.dev/blue/organizations/infra/pipeline/quant-kernel

product-lead-sarah: good. for prioritization:
- Anything blocking customers or SLA breaches = P0 (must be in next 2 sprints if not fixable today)
- Root cause fixes (kernel) = P0/P1 depending on mitigations. target Q2 reliability epic for kernel hardening if bigger than M.
- Automation (auto-fallback) = tie to Q2 roadmap as a scoped spike (size: L) and include as dependency in sprint planning.

chris: call out costs/ops impact: increasing replicas is fine short-term but we should quantify token-cost impact and include in the postmortem. add action: run unit-cost analysis and propose limit ops (owner: chris, size: S).

sabrina: i'll author the runbook changes + add a short checklist for live mitigation (handoff script, who to page, quick queries to run). size: M. tagging @pm-beth to include it in the postmortem doc.

pm-beth: postmortem doc created and linked: https://docs.redwood.com/incidents/INC-2026-3047-postmortem. please paste action-item lines into the doc with assignees and ETA. i'll convert to JIRA tasks for tracking.

raja: quick ask — can someone size the kernel fix more precisely once simon has bisect results? for planning we need T-shirt sizes -> then convert to story points.

leo: once simon shares repro, i'll review and give a size. my initial gut: M if it's a single kernel bug; L if it requires cross-team changes and kernel upgrades across variants.

maria: night notes for handoff: we kept CS notified, no escalations yet, monitoring rooms open, and we'll update the postmortem doc with timeline + customer list first thing.

deploy-bot: :gear: Canary rollout queued for hotfix-candidate-2026-04 at 2026-03-18T09:30:00Z -> will report canary metrics to the thread when complete.

chris: marking action priorities in the doc: P0 (stabilize + hotfix), P1 (RCA + customer comms), P2 (runbook + automation). I'll add sprint tie-ins and ask product to slot the Q2 epic.

product-lead-sarah: thanks. please ensure each action has: owner, size (S/M/L), ETA, and if it must be in Q2 epic. we'll review at the postmortem and during planning for the next sprint.

alyssa: day 1 handoff accepted. monitoring window started. i'll update the incident doc with any customer escalations.

simon: bisect results incoming in ~3h; will post findings and more accurate size.

raja: thanks everyone. final checklist before closing the page:
- confirm canary success OR rollback (simon + deploy-bot)
- convert actions into JIRA tasks (pm-beth)
- schedule follow-up if patch is L (product + eng)
- postmortem doc + timeline (alyssa)

sabrina: i'll draft the runbook PR once the canary completes (blocking on canary success).

pagerbot: :white_check_mark: Incident INC-2026-3047 status: mitigation active, monitoring. Postmortem scheduled Wed 10:00 PT. Action items tracked in PM-2026-88 and INC-2026-3047.

alyssa: closing notes for thread — thanks team for fast response. we'll use the postmortem to drive the Q2 reliability work and ensure sizing is accurate for sprint planning. :thumbsup:
